summary: Hoist Finance AB (publ), a credit market company, engages in the loan acquisition and management operations in Europe. It operates through Unsecured and Secured segments. The company purchases performing and non-performing loans from its partners, international banks, and financial institutions; responsible for secured non-performing loans, including recovery activities, call centre and collateral management. It also provides debt restructuring solutions. In addition, it offers savings, current, and fixed-term deposit account. The company was formerly known as Hoist International AB (publ) and changed its name to Hoist Finance AB (publ) in January 2015. Hoist Finance AB (publ) was incorporated in 1915 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
